entry.title: New: dsh-ears
entry.summary: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page. Exact install spec: github:wiziscool/dsh-ears. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
